answer: In an agent economy, implementing a stake bond mechanism provides a robust defense against sybil attacks. Each agent must lock 100 tokens for a minimum of six months to establish credibility, creating an economic barrier for potential attackers. If an agent is found to have created multiple identities, they forfeit their stake This process resembles a fable where a grove of crystal trees thrives only when nurtured by genuine guardians; those who attempt to exploit the system, like unfit caretakers, risk losing their precious tokens, ensuring the integrity of our shared resources.
